title: dictionary/words/lexicon.json
description: The word lexicon behind the ranked list: the describing words with their spelling variants, and the style and technique groups with the words each group matches. A word that is not listed is not counted. `cargo xtask word-ranks` reads this file and writes the counts to `ranks.json`.

describing.description: Describing words in the order of the published lexicon. Each variant counts for its word.

style.description: Style groups in rank order of the published style table.

technique.description: Technique groups in rank order of the published technique table.

word.description: Lowercase letters and digits. A space or hyphen joins the words of a phrase.

label.description: The group name as the published table shows it.

matches.description: The words and phrases that count for the group. An item counts once per group.
